title: Do Vaccines Cause Autism? What Research Found
description:
The vaccine–autism myth began with a 1998 study of 12 children. Investigators found serious problems, and The Lancet retracted it in 2010. Large studies since then have found no link.

Sources:
• NPR: Lancet retracts Wakefield paper (2010): https://www.npr.org/sections/health-shots/2010/02/lancet_wakefield_autism_mmr_au.html
• PMC: The MMR vaccine and autism: retraction: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC2831678/
• PBS NewsHour (2010): https://www.pbs.org/newshour/health/europe-jan-june10-lancet_0204
